scope: Only published YouTube specimen evidence and claim metadata, not arbitrary site files, screenshots, connected accounts or hidden/embedded external material.
detection_behavior: Fail the repository verification when forbidden keys, email patterns or recognizable secret formats appear in published YouTube source or claim fields. Report field/path identifiers only, not candidate secret content.
privacy_guards: The scanning code must not fetch personal records, device locations, user histories or credentials.
Never emit candidate token or email contents in CI logs.
A legitimate public figure's name or a publisher URL is not automatically a private identifier.
A passed pattern check is not privacy approval, copyright clearance, or proof that prose contains no inadvertently identifying details.
Individual child users and inferred sensitive demographic labels are forbidden in research data; human review remains necessary to assess less recognizable leaks.
Do not collect any additional personal data for the sake of testing this guard.
